item.title: PM Modi hails AI Impact Summit as global game-changer in Mann Ki Baat
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed India’s AI Impact Summit, where global leaders and tech CEOs attended the summit and interacted with Modi, in his 131st Mann Ki Baat on Sunday, February 22.

item.title: Terror plot busted in Tamil Nadu, West Bengal: 8 suspects arrested; links to ISI, Bangladesh under probe
item.description: According to reports, the arrested accused were planning a major crime in India. Further investigations are likely to reveal details about their network, funding, and foreign connections. They were posting content on social media in support of Pakistani terrorist organizations.

item.title: Holi 2026: Easy ways to make lal gulal at home with natural ingredients
item.description: Celebrate Holi the safe and eco-friendly way by transforming simple flowers into vibrant, skin-loving colours at home. Discover a natural alternative that protects your family, saves money, and keeps traditions pure — keep reading to see how surprisingly easy it is.

item.title: England vs Sri Lanka T20 WC Super 8: With rain threat looming large, is another washout on the cards?
item.description: After Colombo witnessed heavy rain during the Super 8 opener, Pallekele is also expected to see some showers putting the match between England and Sri Lanka under serious threat.

item.title: Riverside camping, lathmaar, flower showers to luxury lawns: Holi 2026 events in Mumbai promise unforgettable colour
item.description: Mumbai gears up for Holi 2026 with rain dance parties, celebrity DJs, family-friendly festivals and vibrant colour celebrations across malls, lawns and riverside venues in and around the city. Check out the top spots.

item.title: NSE boosts speed 1000x: High-frequency trading & foray into New Asset Classes
item.description: Considering the continuously increasing trading activity in the market, NSE is upgrading its speed from microseconds to nanoseconds. Higher speed and lower latency mean that even amid large volumes, orders will be processed quickly.

item.title: Former Assam Congress chief Bhupen Borah joins BJP ahead of state assembly polls
item.description: After spending over three decades in the Congress, Ex-Assam PCC chief Bhupen Borah joins the BJP ahead of the upcoming Assembly elections intensifying the political battle in the state.

item.title: ‘Fire her or pay the consequences’: Donald Trump’s direct Netflix warning on Susan Rice
item.description: President Trump demands Netflix fire Susan Rice, ex-Obama aide, for her podcast threat to punish firms cozying up to him, warning of consequences. “Fire her IMMEDIATELY or pay the price,” he posted on Truth Social.

item.title: Grok 4.1 Fast has been added to Microsoft Copilot Studio
item.description: xAI’s Grok 4.1 Fast is now available in preview inside Microsoft Copilot Studio for select US users. The text-based model supports complex reasoning tasks but does not generate images or multimedia content.

item.title: ChatGPT-fueled mass cheating scandal rocks Maharashtra board exams; 5 exam invigilators suspended
item.description: Students allegedly used ChatGPT to generate answers from question paper photos, which were then smuggled and distributed.
